# Java Audiveris 5.11 (JDK 25) StaffManager.getClosestStaff over a 64-pixel
# lattice, for chula.png.
#
# Staff areas are graded behaviourally rather than structurally: a
# java.awt.geom.Area is not worth serialising, and getClosestStaff is the only
# thing that consumes one. A point is assigned to a staff whose *area contains
# it*, and among those to the nearest -- so this exercises containment and the
# distance tie-break together.
#
# Generated by oracle/java/SigProbe.java (the `closest` record).
#
